p: Highgate is one of Kendal's main streets, running south from the town centre, and it's home to the Brewery Arts Centre, with its cinema, theatre and café bar, so there's plenty going on round here of an evening. At the southern end you'll find Abbot Hall art gallery and Kendal's big parish church by the River Kent.

Kendal calls itself the gateway to the Lake District, and with Windermere only a short drive or train ride away, plenty of people pass through on their way to the lakes. Don't leave without a bar of Kendal Mint Cake, and the ruins of Kendal Castle on the hill make a cracking short walk with views over the town.
It's 18+ only, so bring ID if you're likely to be asked.
